message: That's right! Your eyes help you see the world around you.
Good try! Think about what body part helps you see. It's not your ears.
Remember, organs work together! Your eyes don't work alone — they send signals to your brain.
You understand organ functions well! Let's explore how they work together.
Correct! Food goes from your mouth to your esophagus before reaching your stomach.
Almost! Think about what connects your mouth to your stomach.
Don't skip the esophagus! Food travels through the esophagus — a tube that connects your mouth to your stomach.
The stomach breaks down food, but the small intestine is where most nutrients are absorbed.
Great! Healthy food can be delicious and fun to eat.
Good try! Think about what makes a meal balanced.
Healthy food doesn't have to taste bad! Fruits, smoothies, and colorful vegetables are healthy and tasty.
